'''Dominic Gaudreault Origins by Dom (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Dominic Gaudreault]] posted on DeckTech on 15 August 2000 about [[2000 Origins Open]].<ref name="tr-d1131">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-15-origins-by-domd1131/ origins-by-dom], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 15 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-15-origins-by-domd1131/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Dominic Gaudreault finished 24th at the 2000 Origins Open, going 3–3 (8 (+35)) with Set Your Course For Alderaan and Mind What You Have Learned, after a 5–1 day (5th individually) in the team event and a 3–1 Light Side run in the Death Star II pre-release.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Dominic Gaudreault]] (byline: Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault)
* '''Published:''' 15 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Origins by Dom''
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Origins Open]]
* '''Event date:''' 15 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Finish:''' 24th
* '''Record:''' 3–3
* '''Points:''' 8 (+35)
* '''Dark deck:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan, 'Why Dominic Is Superman' (built to beat Throne Room mains)]]
* '''Light deck:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned with Yoda, the Super Falcon and Jedi Test 1 (deck name crude, see report)]]

== Side event: 2000 Origins Team Event ==

The report also covers [[2000 Origins Team Event]] (14 July 2000). Dominic Gaudreault went 5–1 (10 (+115)) and finished 5th individually for his pick-up team 'the Real Scrub' in the Origins 2000 team tournament, losing only to Steve Brentson; Gary Carman's team won.

== Side event: 2000 Origins Death Star II Pre-Release ==

The report also covers [[2000 Origins Death Star II Pre-Release]] (16 July 2000). On the last day of Origins 2000 Dominic Gaudreault went 3–1 on Light Side in the Death Star II sealed pre-release, finishing 3rd among the Light Side players; Yannick Lapointe won.
